explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 58 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the morphine sulfate injection shortage on 2017-10-31 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21, spanning 108 months on the list.
The Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plant (FEI 3001833549) received an OAI classification letter dated 2017-12-28, which was 58 days after the initial shortage posting.
That same plant had a prior OAI inspection ending 2011-07-08 and another OAI inspection ending 2013-01-11, with a Warning Letter issued 2012-02-22.
The most recent inspection of the Fresenius Kabi plant ended 2023-10-13 and was classified VAI.
Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (FEI 2220525) is also listed as a current shortage manufacturer; its latest inspection ended 2024-06-12 and was classified VAI.
Corvale East has 11 days on hand, Corvale General has 19 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 22 days of morphine sulfate at current usage rates.
The approved therapeutic interchange is the same product from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (NDC 63323045201, 2 mg/mL), approved by Casey Nguyen, MD on 2025-10-09, requiring pharmacist substitution.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-1b81dd.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%morphine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%morphine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-b55bdf.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('ebb18761-e5c4-4238-bb84-f9549f500210', '582f42e5-444e-4246-af8c-e7e28097c69a', 'e9a7319a-bf1f-48db-a71e-6d4e6ead9555') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-8de150.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%morphine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-f1ef8b.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%morphine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-4dc1de.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%morphine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-1c6bed.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3001833549', '2220525', '3008887707', '1021343', '2016148') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-b798bb.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3001833549', '2220525', '3008887707', '1021343', '2016148') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-4133d5.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3001833549', '2220525') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('fresenius kabi', 'winder winder', 'hikma')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-16b25d.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('fresenius kabi', 'winder winder', 'hikma', 'hospira', 'winder') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%morphine%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-7a0482.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('732653', '815426') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-59293c.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00409189001', '00641601910', '63323045201', '75826013005')
